name: beU delivery
long_description: beU delivery is an on-demand food delivery service in Africa. We offer a great selection of local restaurants and door-to-door food delivery that allows the customer to have their favorite food from the comfort of their home or office. We are the #1 food delivery service in Ethiopia, deliver at significantly cheaper rate than our peers, making food delivery affordable for the mass. We plan to expand our services to new markets and eventually become the super app of Africa.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
I graduated with double majors in Mathematics and Chemistry (Honor program) from University of California, San Diego. Then, I went onto the Johns Hopkins University to do a master in Bioinformatics but dropped out midway to work on starting a company instead. While going to school, I involved myself in liver, head and neck research, authoring eight peer-reviewed publications, with five as the first author.
On a personal level, I really love Math and the universality of human connections.
